alate: Head brownish, postclypeus and antennae slightly paler, pale yellowish brown; pronotum yellowish brown, wings greyish brown. Head broadly oval. Compound eyes circular, distinctly projecting; ocelli elliptical, the ocellus–compound eye distance greater than the width of the ocellus itself. Postclypeus slightly raised, about one-third as long as wide. Fontanelle elongate-oval, medium-sized, situated at the centre of the shallow concavity of the vertex between the two compound eyes. Antennae 15 segments, the third the shortest and smallest, the fourth and fifth roughly equal. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin straight, the anterior part slightly raised, the central incisions of the anterior and posterior margins indistinct. Forewing scale larger than the hindwing scale; the media of the forewing arising independently at the humeral suture, nearer the radial sector, the whole vein rather close to the cubitus, giving off one to three branches to the wing apex from about half the wing length or from the apical third; the cubitus with about 7–10 branches.
